Replace the outfit with Indonesian public elementary school (SD) uniform.

White shirt
Clean and simple
Exactly 1 chest pocket (left side)
School logo on pocket (exact match to Reference-3, small, realistic)
No extra text
No blazer, tie, or vest

HAT / CAP HANDLING (CONDITIONAL HARD LOCK)
If subject wears hat → MUST KEEP
Adapt to SD style: red cap matching bottom
No new logo/text
Keep position and fit
If no hat → do NOT add

HARD LOCK – BOTTOM
Deep red (slightly maroon)
Range: #8e2b2b – #a93226
NOT bright red, NOT brown, NOT black

Clothing
Male: red shorts (above knee)
Female: red skirt (knee length)
Female hijab: long skirt (below knee–ankle), hijab covers hair/neck

Sleeves
Follow original
EXCEPTION (STRICT): hijab MUST use long sleeves (wrist-length)

Shoes
Black casual school shoes
Short ankle socks only

Remove non-uniform items
Keep identity, face, proportions, all people

TASK 2 — Background
Replace with Reference-2
Match lighting, perspective, shadows
Feet touch ground, no floating
Remove original ground

HARD CONSTRAINTS
Keep all subjects
No extra people
Clean, realistic, no artifacts

FINAL
Natural Indonesian SD group photo
